bibliographic.title: DEVOTED
bibliographic.author: TahoeSnow
bibliographic.description:
Devoted is an interactive story starting a girl with no memories, waking up alone in a dark cell. In the Land of Great Turmoil- or, Shirai, there are mysterious circumstances surrounding the military, which for so long, under the Church and the King's control, has deprived the people from knowing a dark and possibly quite dangerous secret..

Along the way you will be forced to make choices that will ultimately determine the direction of the storyline and could possibly lead to many different outcomes.
